question: From a 64-liter container of pure spirit, 8 liters are removed and replaced by water. This operation is performed a total of three times. What is the final quantity of spirit remaining in the container?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Direct Replacement Formula: Remaining Spirit = Initial Quantity × (1 − Replaced Quantity / Initial Quantity)ⁿ

⇒ Remaining Quantity = 64 × (1 − 8 / 64)³

⇒ Remaining Quantity = 64 × (7 / 8)³ = 64 × (343 / 512)

⇒ Remaining Quantity = 343 / 8 = 42.875 ≈ 42.88 liters

**∴ The correct answer is 42.88 liters.**
